'''Phillip Rowell''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[December 2000 Virginia Beach tournament]] on 30 December 2000 with [[Bring Him Before Me / Take Your Father's Place|BHBM]], according to Brian Catalino's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1579">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-12-30-virginia-beach-va-12-30-00d1579/ virginia-beach-va-12-30-00], DeckTech (brian "darkjedi2000" catalino, 30 December 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-12-30-virginia-beach-va-12-30-00d1579/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
